modules.name: GENRA Generative Sequencer
modules.description: Genre-aware generative sequencer: 8 drum voices, bass, melody and polyphonic pads with shared chord progressions

modules.name: GENRA Grid Editor
modules.description: Grid editor for GENRA: drum grid, piano roll and velocity lane for every track, docks next to GENRA

modules.name: JIANT VOICE
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's VOICE engine: a formant singer (vowels, and words in Spanish, English and Japanese, your own lyrics), its vocal tract drawn live

modules.name: JIANT DRUM-X
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's DRUM-X drum synth: 8 synthesized sounds with A/B morph, 9 kits, individual outputs, its kit of creatures drawn live

modules.name: JIANT ANIMAL
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's ANIMAL engine: animal calls from physical models (CMOS bird machine, cricket pulses, syrinx whistle, wing tones, glottis), with its creature drawn live
